name: Chasm
author: E. T. Carter
description: Twilight on a glacier, standing at the lip of a crevasse that winds off toward a far snow ridge: white ice walls banded with clear violet and dusty strata, scalloped by melt, sink to ember-black while snow bridges with hanging icicles span the slot. Wind-carved drifts in deep violet shade catch a low warm sun on their crests as the view creeps slowly along the crack.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the view creeps along the crevasse.

params.label: Ice strata
params.effect: How many ice bands are stacked down the walls.

params.label: Sun
params.effect: Strength of the low warm sun on the drifts, walls and haze.

params.label: Absorption
params.effect: How quickly the ice swallows light going down the crack, from a glowing slot to a short white lip over black.
